title: Freya and the Sigil Again
author: Hazel Halloran
blurb: Oscar Oyelaran, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
